requests.outcome: HTTP 200 over TLS. Current HTML was inspected; it was a WordPress landing/corporate shell and did not expose an anonymous parcel map/API URL, layer schema, CRS, or parcel response. No login was attempted.
Bounded 20-second TLS-verified GET timed out. No response body, schema, CRS, native ID, or geometry was observed.

HTTP 200 first-party guidance. It documents anonymous/public viewer workflows by click, address, parcel code, and coordinates and says a selected polygon can be downloaded as JSON, but it did not provide a Yopal parcel response in this attempt.

queryOutcomes: Separate English and Spanish first-party discovery queries were executed and recorded in city-4860-yopal.json. They identified the official Yopal geovisor, the local cadastral gestor evidence, and IGAC open-data/query guidance.
